finding: Serial scientific tasks must not inherit a GPU lock from a long-lived lane or supervisor.

runtime_audit.reason: Each held flock still had an active training process and allocated CUDA memory; low instantaneous utilization alone is not proof of idleness.

source_remediation: parallel_single_gpu reacquires the lock independently for every ImageNet scientific task
DARTS resume tasks 2 and 3 reacquire the shared fourth GPU independently
lock owner labels identify the task or active packed task set rather than a generic lane
packed execution retains one lock only while its concurrently packed scientific tasks remain active
immutable_snapshot_boundary: The AutoFormer run started from an older read-only source snapshot. It was not hot-patched or terminated because all four held locks mapped to active training lanes. Future launches use the corrected source after commit.
safety_policy: kernel flock is the only lock authority
never unlink a lock pathname to bypass a held flock
verify owner PID, child tree, run identity, logs and CUDA processes before TERM
release and reacquire between serial tasks even when they share a scheduler lane
